stop!

not typing anything - and i have two snapshots - one before do-release-upgrade and one after

"sudo nano /etc/apt/sources.list"
i apologize, but i think i was providing you incorrect information
when that is done run a "sudo apt-get update&&sudo apt-get dist-uprade" to get the latest packages from 14.04.
i did start do-release-upgrade -d before I ctrl-c'd it - i saw this as a suggested solution for my problem before i came here
i am on trusty, but my kernel is 3.11
your system is a mess. see my last advices to get that to a proper state again

"sudo apt-get update &&sudo apt-get dist-upgrade"
correct, but that's not grabbing the new kernel
let it run

its not grabbing anything because that system is a mess. when that command is done we go further

now again: "apt-cache policy linux-image-generic"

http://pastebin.com/dnkcS1C0

ok, now what?

http://pastebin.com/eRFukZic
i dont know why it doesnt list you all packages but only the installed ones. but after a reboot that should be on kernel 3.13 now
thanks!

from now on be carefull with upgrade commands and the developer switches
